meta.name: igce-builder-lh-tm
meta.description: Build IGCEs for Labor Hour (LH) and Time-and-Materials (T&M) federal contracts using burden multiplier pricing. Orchestrates BLS OEWS, GSA CALC+, and GSA Per Diem. T&M adds materials at cost (FAR 16.601(b)). Supports SOW/PWS decomposition and CALC+ rate validation. Trigger for: LH IGCE, T&M IGCE, labor hour estimate, time and materials estimate, burden multiplier, burdened rate, IGCE with travel or materials, CALC+ rate comparison. Do NOT use for FFP (use IGCE Builder FFP), cost-reimbursement CPFF/CPAF/CPIF (use IGCE Builder CR), or grant budgets (use Grant Budget Builder). Requires the bls-oews, gsa-calc, and gsa-perdiem MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成联邦合同的人工工时与材料成本估算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为联邦T&M合同编制IGCE成本估算。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly generate labor hour and T&M cost estimates for federal contracts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare IGCE cost estimates for federal T&M contracts.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你生成联邦政府工料合同的成本估算。它会从BLS、GSA等数据库拉取工资和费率数据，填入表格，但不会判断价格是否合理——结论由你来做。
howto.when: 当你要求“估算工料合同成本”、“对比供应商报价”或“验证费率”时触发。需要先装好bls-oews、gsa-calc和gsa-perdiem三个数据服务。

say.text: 帮我做一个华盛顿DC软件工程师的工料合同成本估算。
say.note: Claude会收集岗位、地点等信息，然后生成估算表。

say.text: 验证一下这个供应商的费率是否合理：高级分析师，时薪$150。
say.note: Claude会拉取市场数据做对比，但不会下结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you generate cost estimates for federal labor-hour and time-and-materials contracts. It pulls wage and rate data from BLS, GSA, and other databases, and formats them into a workbook, but does not judge whether prices are reasonable—you make that decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'estimate labor-hour contract costs', 'compare vendor pricing', or 'validate rates'. Requires the bls-oews, gsa-calc, and gsa-perdiem MCP servers to be installed.

say_en.text: Create a labor-hour cost estimate for a software engineer in Washington, DC.
say_en.note: Claude will collect inputs and generate an estimate table.

say_en.text: Validate this vendor rate: senior analyst, $150/hr.
say_en.note: Claude will pull market data for comparison but will not conclude.
